context.scene_title: Deling City assassination mission — mixed shots around the parade climax: Squall amid icy magic, a dim gate confrontation, and a luxury car at the Presidential gate (Disc 1).
locations: Deling City — a teal magical/void space around Squall, a dark gated interior with two figures, and the night streets/Presidential Residence gate where a silver convertible drives

characters.name: Squall Leonhart
characters.recognition: Young man with brown hair, blue eyes and the signature vertical scar between his brows, fur-collared jacket and silver chain; shown straining with arms raised amid teal magical particles.

characters.name: (second confrontation figure)
characters.recognition: A figure wielding a long blade faces another in a dim gated hall; not positively identified (possibly Seifer or a guard).

characters.name: (silver automobile)
characters.recognition: A classic silver convertible limousine driving the Deling City streets and gate — a Deling City vehicle (likely the presidential/Caraway car); no occupant identifiable.

context.summary: The clip opens on Squall, scarred face strained and hands raised, suspended in a teal field of magical particles. It cuts to a shadowy confrontation between two figures in a gated hall, then to a sleek silver convertible speeding through Deling City past the ornate Presidential Residence gate at night.
context.context_note: Squall is positively identified. The clip appears to splice several beats of the Deling City assassination mission; the precise plot placement of each shot (and the car's owner) is uncertain.
